name: Catacombs Near Lower Rubble B source

provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: second production parallax variation; camera-relative near-depth lower-wall and rubble overlay for a side-view 2D exploration platformer.
Primary request: Create exactly one coherent, compositionally distinctive lower-wall ruin formation. Center the design on one broad collapsed breach with diagonal fallen lintels, uneven rubble shelves, eroded masonry slopes, small bone deposits naturally integrated into debris, and broken low retaining courses. Use asymmetrical large and small negative openings. Make it clearly unlike a regular wall with repeated short column bases or sarcophagus blocks.
Scene/backdrop: Every pixel not occupied by the ruin subject must be the single exact flat removal matte color #FF00FF, RGBA (255, 0, 255, 255). No gradients, noise, shadows, texture, color variation, transparency, or stray pixels in the matte. The outermost 7 percent of the canvas on both left and right must be completely empty, uninterrupted uniform #FF00FF matte from top to bottom; no subject pixel may enter either gutter or touch either lateral image edge. Taper the masonry into irregular rubble before each gutter. Both lateral edges must match exactly so the full canvas tiles seamlessly in horizontal repetition. Designed for 96-pixel overlap with neighbors.
Subject: A broad, horizontally layered subterranean ruin silhouette, never tower-like. The connected formation spans nearly the full canvas height: irregular upper contour begins within the top 4 percent; broad lower foundation terminates within the bottom 4 percent. Do not leave large unused matte bands above or below. No detached objects.
Style/medium: crisp, hand-authored 16-bit pixel art for production game art; chunky deliberate pixel clusters; hard pixel edges; carefully stepped diagonals; no smoothing, antialiasing, painterly blending, blur, or soft transparency.
Composition/framing: exact landscape target aspect ratio 960:540 (16:9), full-canvas environment composition. Strong readable silhouette and broad value groups. Dominant collapsed breach offset from center, diagonal lintels creating directional energy, asymmetrical distribution of voids and rubble masses. Preserve completely clean 7-percent magenta lateral gutters while filling nearly all vertical extent between them. Horizontal tile compatibility is mandatory.
Lighting/mood: cold upper-left subterranean light, restrained and readable.
Color palette: dark navy and indigo stone, desaturated blue-purple midtones, restrained pale-blue bone highlights, against only the exact #FF00FF matte.
Materials/textures: eroded block masonry, fractured lintels, layered rubble shelves, worn low retaining courses, modest bone fragments embedded into debris; use chunky pixel clusters rather than fine noise.
Constraints: Generate exactly one image and output it as one PNG. No text, border, UI, picture frame, or watermark. Keep strong silhouettes. Background/removal pixels must use exactly #FF00FF RGBA 255,0,255,255 and no other background color. No subject pixels whatsoever within the outermost 7 percent at left or right. No large matte bands above or below.
Avoid: regular grid; evenly spaced motifs; repeated short column bases; repeating sarcophagi; sarcophagus blocks; tall pedestals; full-height columns; arches; ceilings; large skull motifs; characters; standalone props; detached objects; floor plane; text; UI; border; watermark; painterly blur; smoothing; antialiasing; shadows or glow spilling into the matte; visible pixels in lateral gutters; large unused top and bottom bands.
